title: Angry Stuff
description: a random ore appeared underground that made everything angry, tools, armor, a dimension, nothing escapes the angry
body:
# what does the mod add?

this mod adds a ton of angry stuff (as you can read by the name), including:

an angryanium ore, that drops raw angryanium able to be smelted into angryanium ingots (only 1 spawns per chunk, but they only spawn on a specific Y level, so be on the lookout on what Y level you find these ores

a BRAND NEW angry dimension, discover a new dimension with tons of angry blocks being crafted into angryanium ingots, when youve entered this dimension you basically have angryanium for life, but be warned, every time you enter the dimension a hundred angry mans spawn to hunt you down, when killed, they might drop a singular angryanium ingot but if youre lucky they drop the angry heart able to be crafted into the VERY ANGRY SWORD!!!! when fused with a netherite ingot

a BRAND NEW entity, angryman, spawns in the angry dimension

tools:

angry pickaxe, angry axe, angry sword, angry hoe, angry shovel and of course the VERY ANGRY SWORD!!!!

armor:

full angryanium armor is able to be gotten in this mod

upcoming:

a brand new angry bossfight

a collab with test horror mod, where you will get more content when both mods are active



updates for this mod might take a while to come out since the full focus currently is on test horror mod
